answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a secure haven against Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic verification of unique human attributes. In a digital economy where malicious actors might fabricate a fable of multiple identities to drain resources, this mechanism forces an attacker to reach a nadir of profitability. By anchoring participation to scarce, non-duplicable biological or social traits, the system imposes a prohibitive cost on identity generation, ensuring that every AI agent remains tethered to a distinct actor.
